preconditions.description: The input s must be a string.
The length of the input string s must be between 1 and 10000 characters.

preconditions.expression: any(c.isalpha() or c.isdigit() for c in s)
preconditions.description: The input string s must contain at least one letter or digit.

postconditions.description: The output must be the words in the input string s reversed and concatenated by a single space.
The output must not contain any multiple spaces between words.
The output must not have leading or trailing spaces.
